mn14:1.2: Ekaṃ samayaṃ Bhagavā Sakkesu viharati Kapilavatthusmiṃ Nigrodhārāme.
mn14:2.1: Atha kho Mahānāmo Sakko yena Bhagavā ten' upasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā Bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. Ekamantaṃ nisinno kho Mahānāmo Sakko Bhagavantaṃ etadavoca:
mn14:2.2: Dīgharattāhaṃ bhante Bhagavatā evaṃ dhammaṃ desitaṃ ājānāmi:
mn14:2.3: Lobho cittassa upakkileso, doso cittassa upakkileso, moho cittassa upakkileso ti. Evaṃ
mn14:2.4: cāhaṃ bhante Bhagavatā dhammaṃ desitaṃ ājānāmi:
mn14:2.5: Lobho cittassa upakkileso, doso c. u., moho c. u. ti,
mn14:2.6: atha ca pana me ekadā lobhadhammā pi cittaṃ pariyādāya tiṭṭhanti, dosadhammā pi cittaṃ pariyādāya tiṭṭhanti, mohadhammā pi cittaṃ pariyādāya tiṭṭhanti.
mn14:2.8: Ko su nāma me dhammo ajjhattaṃ appahīno yena me ekadā lobhadhammā pi cittaṃ pariyādāya tiṭṭhanti, dosadhammā pi c. p. tiṭṭhanti, mohadhammā pi c. p. tiṭṭhantīti.
mn14:3.1: So eva kho te Mahānāma dhammo ajjhattaṃ appahīno yena te ekadā lobhadhammā pi cittaṃ pariyādāya tiṭṭhanti. dosadhammā pi c. p. tiṭṭhanti, mohadhammā pi c. p. tiṭṭhanti.
mn14:3.2: So ca hi te Mahānāma dhammo ajjhattaṃ pahīno abhavissa, na tvaṃ agāraṃ ajjhāvaseyyāsi, na kāme paribhuñjeyyāsi.
mn14:3.3: Yasmā ca kho te Mahānāma so eva dhammo ajjhattaṃ appahīno, tasmā tvaṃ agāraṃ ajjhāvasasi, kāme paribhuñjasi.
mn14:4.1: Appassādā kāmā bahudukkhā bahupāyāsā, ādīnavo ettha bhiyyo ti
mn14:4.2: iti ce pi Mahānāma ariyasāvakassa yathābhūtaṃ sammappaññāya sudiṭṭhaṃ hoti. So ca aññatr' eva kāmehi aññatra akusalehi dhammehi pītisukhaṃ nādhigacchati aññaṃ vā tato santataraṃ,
mn14:4.3: atha kho so n' eva tāva anāvaṭṭī kāmesu hoti.
mn14:4.4: Yato ca kho Mahānāma ariyasāvakassa: appassādā kāmā bahudukkhā bahupāyāsā, ādīnavo ettha bhiyyo ti evam-etaṃ yathābhūtaṃ sammappaññāya sudiṭṭhaṃ hoti, so ca aññatr' eva kāmehi aññatra akusalehi dhammehi pītisukhaṃ adhigacchati aññañ-ca tato santataraṃ,
mn14:4.5: atha kho so anāvaṭṭī kāmesu hoti.
mn14:5.1: Mayham-pi kho Mahānāma pubbe va sambodhā anabhisambuddhassa bodhisattass' eva sato: \ [... content straddling page break has been moved to the page above ...] \
mn14:5.2: appassādā kāmā bahudukkhā bahupāyāsā, ādīnavo ettha bhiyyo ti evam-etaṃ yathābhūtaṃ sammappaññāya sudiṭṭhaṃ ahosi,
mn14:5.3: so ca aññatr' eva kāmehi aññatra akusalehi dhammehi pītisukhaṃ nājjhagamaṃ aññaṃ vā tato santataraṃ,
mn14:5.4: atha khvāhaṃ n' eva tāva anāvaṭṭī kāmesu paccaññāsiṃ.
mn14:5.5: Yato ca kho me Mahānāma: appassādā kāmā bahudukkhā bahupāyāsā, ādīnavo ettha bhiyyo ti evam-etaṃ yathābhūtaṃ sammappaññāya sudiṭṭhaṃ ahosi, so ca aññatr' eva kāmehi aññatra akusalehi dhammehi pītisukhaṃ ajjhagamaṃ aññañ-ca tato santataraṃ,
mn14:6.4: cakkhuviññeyyā rūpā iṭṭhā kantā manāpā piyarūpā kāmūpasaṃhitā rajanīyā,
mn14:6.8: kāyaviññeyyā phoṭṭhabbā iṭṭhā kantā manāpā piyarūpā kāmūpasaṃhitā rajanīyā.
mn14:6.10: Yaṃ kho Mahānāma ime pañca kāmaguṇe paṭicca uppajjati sukhaṃ somanassaṃ,
mn14:7.2: (repeat from p. 85, l.30 to p. 87, l.26, with Mahānāma substituted
mn14:14.3: Mahānāma kāmānaṃ ādīnavo samparāyiko dukkhakkhandho kāmahetu kāmanidānaṃ kāmādhikaraṇaṃ kāmānam-eva hetu.
mn14:15.1: Ekam-idāhaṃ Mahānāma samayaṃ Rājagahe viharāmi Gijjhakūṭe pabbate.
mn14:15.2: Tena kho pana samayena sambahulā nigaṇṭhā Isigilipasse Kāḷasilāyaṃ ubbhaṭṭhakā honti āsanapaṭikkhittā, opakkamikā dukkhā tippā kaṭukā vedanā vediyanti.
mn14:16.1: Atha kho 'haṃ Mahānāma sāyanhasamayaṃ paṭisallāṇā vuṭṭhito yena Isigilipassaṃ Kāḷasilā yena te nigaṇṭhā ten' upasaṅkamiṃ, upasaṅkamitvā te nigaṇṭhe etad-avocaṃ:
mn14:16.2: Kin-nu tumhe āvuso nigaṇṭhā ubbhaṭṭhakā āsanapaṭikkhittā opakkamikā dukkhā tippā kaṭukā vedanā vediyathāti.
mn14:17.1: Evaṃ vutte Mahānāma te nigaṇṭhā maṃ etad-avocuṃ:
mn14:17.2: Nigaṇṭho āvuso Nāthaputto sabbaññū sabbadassāvī aparisesaṃ ñāṇadassanaṃ paṭijānāti:
mn14:17.3: carato ca me tiṭṭhato ca suttassa ca jāgarassa ca satataṃ samitaṃ ñāṇadassanaṃ paccupaṭṭhitan-ti; \ [... content straddling page break has been moved to the page above ...] \
mn14:17.5: Atthi kho vo nigaṇṭhā pubbe pāpaṃ kammaṃ kataṃ. taṃ imāya kaṭukāya dukkarakārikāya nijjaretha;
mn14:17.6: yaṃ pan' ettha etarahi kāyena saṃvutā vācāya saṃvutā manasā saṃvutā taṃ āyatiṃ pāpassa kammassa akaraṇaṃ;
mn14:17.7: iti purāṇānaṃ kammānaṃ tapasā byantibhāvā navānaṃ kammānaṃ akaraṇā āyatiṃ anavassavo,
mn14:17.8: āyatiṃ anavassavā kammakkhayo, kammakkhayā dukkhakkhayo, dukkhakkhayā vedanākkhayo, vedanākkhayā sabbaṃ dukkhaṃ nijjiṇṇaṃ bhavissatīti.
mn14:17.9: Tañ-ca pan' amhākaṃ ruccati c' eva khamati ca. tena c' amhā attamanā ti.
mn14:18.1: Evaṃ vutte ahaṃ Mahānāma te nigaṇṭhe etad-avocaṃ:
mn14:18.3: ahuvām' eva mayaṃ pubbe, na nāhuvamhāti. --
mn14:18.6: akarām' eva mayaṃ pubbe pāpaṃ kammaṃ, na nākaramhāti.
mn14:18.9: evarūpaṃ vā evarūpaṃ vā pāpaṃ kammaṃ akaramhāti. --
mn14:18.12: ettakaṃ vā dukkhaṃ nijjiṇṇaṃ, ettakaṃ vā dukkhaṃ nijjaretabbaṃ, ettakamhi vā dukkhe nijjiṇṇe sabbaṃ dukkhaṃ nijjiṇṇaṃ bhavissatīti. --
mn14:18.15: diṭṭhe va dhamme akusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ pahānaṃ, kusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ upasampadan-ti. --
mn14:19.1: Iti kira tumhe āvuso nigaṇṭhā na jānātha:
mn14:19.2: ahuvām' eva mayaṃ pubbe na nāhuvamhāti, na jānātha:
mn14:19.3: akarām eva mayaṃ pubbe pāpaṃ kammaṃ na nākaramhāti, na jānātha:
mn14:19.4: evarūpaṃ vā evarūpaṃ vā pāpaṃ kammaṃ akaramhāti, na jānātha:
mn14:19.5: ettakaṃ vā dukkhaṃ nijjiṇṇaṃ ettakaṃ vā dukkhaṃ nijjaretabbaṃ ettakamhi vā dukkhe nijjiṇṇe sabbaṃ dukkhaṃ nijjiṇṇaṃ bhavissatīti,
mn14:19.7: diṭṭhe va dhamme akusulānaṃ dhammānaṃ pahānaṃ kusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ upasampadaṃ.
mn14:19.8: Evaṃ sante āvuso nigaṇṭhā ye loke luddā lohitapāṇino kurārakammantā manussesu paccājātā te nigaṇṭhesu pabbajantīti. --
mn14:20.1: Na kho āvuso Gotama sukhena sukhaṃ adhigantabbaṃ, dukkhena kho sukhaṃ adhigantabbaṃ.
mn14:20.2: Sukhena ca āvuso Gotama sukhaṃ adhigantabbaṃ abhavissa, \ [... content straddling page break has been moved to the page above ...] \ rājā Māgadho Seniyo Bimbisāro sukhaṃ adhigaccheyya, rājā Māgadho S. B. sukhavihāritaro āyasmatā Gotamenāti. --
mn14:20.3: Addhāyasmantehi nigaṇṭhehi sahasā appaṭisaṅkhā vācā bhāsitā:
mn14:20.4: na kho āvuso Gotama sukhena sukhaṃ adhigantabbaṃ, dukkhena kho sukhaṃ adhigantabbaṃ;
mn14:20.5: sukhena ca āvuso Gotama sukhaṃ adhigantabbaṃ abhavissa, rājā Māgadho S. B. sukhaṃ adhigaccheyya, rājā Māgadho S. B. sukhavihāritaro āyasmatā Gotamenāti.
mn14:20.7: ko nu kho āyasmantānaṃ sukhavihāritaro, rājā vā Māgadho S. B. āyasmā vā Gotamo ti --
mn14:20.8: Addhāvuso Gotama amhehi sahasā appaṭisaṅkhā vācā bhāsitā: na kho āvuso Gotama sukhena sukhaṃ adhigantabbaṃ, dukkhena kho sukhaṃ adhigantabbaṃ;
mn14:20.9: sukhena ca āvuso Gotama sukhaṃ adhigantabbaṃ abhavissa, rājā Māgadho S. B. sukhaṃ adhigaccheyya, rājā Māgadho S. B. sukhavihāritaro āyasmatā Gotamenāti.
mn14:20.10: Api ca tiṭṭhat' etaṃ, idāni pi mayaṃ āyasmantaṃ Gotamaṃ pucchāma:
mn14:20.11: Ko nu kho āyasmantānaṃ sukhavihāritaro, rājā vā Māgadho S. B. āyasmā vā Gotamo ti. --
mn14:21.1: Tena h' āvuso nigaṇṭhā tumhe va tattha paṭipucchissāmi, yathā vo khameyya tathā naṃ byākareyyātha.
mn14:21.2: Taṃ kim-maññath' āvuso nigaṇṭhā : pahoti rājā Māgadho S. B.
mn14:21.3: aniñjamāno kāyena abhāsamāno vācaṃ satta rattindivāni ekantasukhapaṭisaṃvedī viharitun-ti. --
mn14:21.5: Taṃ kim-maññath' āvuso nigaṇṭhā: pahoti rājā Māgadho S. B.
mn14:21.6: aniñjamāno kāyena abhāsamāno vācaṃ cha rattindivāni
mn14:21.13: Ahaṃ kho āvuso nigaṇṭhā pahomi aniñjamāno kāyena abhāsamāno vācaṃ ekaṃ rattindivaṃ ekantasukhapaṭisaṃvedī viharituṃ.
mn14:21.14: Ahaṃ kho āvuso nigaṇṭhā pahomi aniñjamāno kāyena abhāsamāno vācaṃ dve rattindivāni
mn14:21.20: Taṃ kim-maññath' āvuso nigaṇṭhā: evaṃ sante ko sukhavihāritaro, rājā vā Māgadho Seniyo Bimbisāro ahaṃ vā ti. --
